title: Terence Tao's ChatGPT conversation about the Jacobian Conjecture counterexample
summary: Famous mathematician Terence Tao engaged in a ChatGPT conversation about a potential counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture, a longstanding unsolved problem in algebraic geometry. Claude Fable (an AI agent) reportedly produced this counterexample, sparking intense discussion on Hacker News with over 500 comments and 887 points.
problem_solved: Potentially provides a counterexample to settle the Jacobian Conjecture, an open problem in mathematics dating back to 1939.
why_valuable: If validated, this would represent a groundbreaking mathematical discovery resolving an 85-year-old conjecture through AI-assisted research.
